subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add a provider-neutral agent/runtime and session-status contract for provider-reported usage charges, with channel/plugin presentation built on top of it?
rationale: The missing data cannot be safely exposed by a narrow OpenRouter-only patch without deciding the stable semantics for provenance, currency, aggregation, persisted session state, and the distinction from existing estimates.

options.title: Adopt a minimal neutral exact-cost contract
options.body: Add an optional source-tagged, currency-aware reported-cost value through the shared usage, agent metadata, and session-status paths, then let plugins or channels opt into presentation.

options.title: Keep exact costs outside core
options.body: Document that OpenRouter cost visibility belongs to an external provider/accounting plugin and do not add runtime or session fields.

options.title: Support estimates only
options.body: Retain the current configured-pricing estimate path and decline provider-reported billing values as a first-class runtime feature.

recommendation.title: Adopt a minimal neutral exact-cost contract
recommendation.body: Add an optional source-tagged, currency-aware reported-cost value through the shared usage, agent metadata, and session-status paths, then let plugins or channels opt into presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session-cost and OpenAI-compatible transport paths, plus the earlier maintainer-facing review, make this the strongest available routing candidate.
